quotes.name: Merkin Jumper
quotes.quote: I've seen that my work as a Social Services Caseworker has a positive impact on the people in my community, and I feel like I'm making a difference in Downtown Oakland. I'm proud to be a part of this community and to be able to help those in need.

quotes.name: Jessie Hess
quotes.quote: I've seen a lot of excitement around Merkin Jumper's performance and I feel like it's bringing a new energy to our city, I'm curious to see how it will all play out.

quotes.name: Dillon Trevor
quotes.quote: I've seen the city come alive when Merkin Jumper performs, it's like the whole neighborhood is buzzing with energy. As a server, I feel the impact on our local businesses, and it's great to see people out and about, enjoying themselves.

quotes.name: Andre Turner
quotes.quote: I've seen the energy around Merkin Jumper's performance bring a lot of excitement to Downtown, and as a Line cook, I feel like it's been good for business, people are coming out and enjoying themselves.
